extra_vocab.en: sounding reasonable and likely to be true
extra_vocab.note: plausible 指說法、理由或解釋「聽起來合理、有可能是真的」，但不保證真的是事實。多益常見於調查報告、客訴處理與會議討論，用來評論某個解釋或藉口。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: plausible 通常形容 explanation、excuse、story 等說法，不形容人；比較級寫成 more plausible。

example.en: The manager asked for a plausible explanation for the delay.
example.zh: 經理要求對延誤給出一個說得通的解釋。

example.en: He gave a plausible excuse for missing the client meeting.
example.zh: 他對缺席客戶會議提出了一個聽起來合理的藉口。

example.en: Your plan seems plausible, but we need more data.
example.zh: 你的計畫看起來合理，但我們還需要更多資料。

examples.en: The report offers three plausible reasons for the drop in sales.
examples.zh: 這份報告為銷售下滑提出了三個合理的原因。

examples.en: Her story sounded plausible, so we refunded the order.
examples.zh: 她的說法聽起來合理，所以我們退了這筆訂單的款項。

examples.en: It is plausible that prices will rise again next quarter.
examples.zh: 價格有可能在下一季再度上漲，這個說法是說得通的。

confusable.diff: possible 是「有可能發生」；plausible 是「說法聽起來合理可信」。
confusable.usage: possible 說的是事情會不會發生；plausible 說的是解釋或理由是否可信。

example.en: It is possible to finish the project by Friday.
example.zh: 週五前完成這個專案是有可能的。

similar.diff: reasonable 是「合情合理、公道的」，也可形容價格；plausible 偏重「聽起來可信」。

example.en: The store offers reasonable prices for office chairs.
example.zh: 這家店的辦公椅價格合理。

similar.diff: believable 是「可信的」，口語常用；plausible 較正式，多用於解釋與理由。

example.en: The story in the ad was not very believable.
example.zh: 廣告裡的故事不太可信。

example.en: Please give a clear reason for the change.
example.zh: 請為這項變更提出明確的理由。

example.en: Being late again is not a good excuse.
example.zh: 再次遲到不是一個好藉口。

example.en: The customer asked for a short explanation of the fee.
example.zh: 客戶要求對這筆費用做簡短說明。

derived.link: plausible 去 le + -ly，副詞字尾，像 possible → possibly

extra_vocab.en: a large group of people walking along a street for a special event
extra_vocab.note: parade 是慶典或活動中的遊行，多益常見於城市活動公告、封街與交通改道、節慶宣傳的情境；動詞可指遊行或炫耀地走過。

example.en: Several parades will take place in the city this weekend.
example.zh: 這個週末市內會舉行好幾場遊行。

example.en: Hundreds of workers paraded through the streets last Friday.
example.zh: 上週五有數百名工人在街上遊行。

example.en: Students are parading down the main street with colorful flags.
example.zh: 學生們拿著彩色旗幟沿著大街遊行。

example.en: The city will hold a parade to celebrate the festival.
example.zh: 市政府將舉辦遊行來慶祝這個節慶。

example.en: Several roads along the parade route will be closed.
example.zh: 遊行路線沿途的幾條道路將會封閉。

example.en: A street parade attracted many visitors to the old town.
example.zh: 一場街頭遊行吸引了許多遊客來到舊城區。

examples.en: The annual parade starts at ten in front of city hall.
examples.zh: 年度遊行上午十點從市政廳前面開始。

examples.en: Buses will take a different route during the parade on Sunday.
examples.zh: 週日遊行期間，公車會改走不同的路線。

examples.en: The parade drew more than fifty thousand people to the downtown area.
examples.zh: 這場遊行吸引了超過五萬人來到市中心。

similar.diff: march 常指為了表達意見而走在街上的示威遊行；parade 多是慶祝性質的遊行。

example.en: Workers planned a peaceful march to the city office.
example.zh: 工人們計畫向市政府進行一場和平的遊行。

example.en: The music festival begins next Friday in the park.
example.zh: 音樂節下週五在公園開始。

example.en: A large crowd gathered to watch the show.
example.zh: 一大群人聚集來看表演。

example.en: Traffic was slow because of a parade near the station.
example.zh: 車站附近有遊行，所以交通很慢。

example.en: Fans will parade through the city to celebrate the win.
example.zh: 球迷將在市區遊行來慶祝勝利。

extra_vocab.en: a doctor who treats people with medicine
extra_vocab.note: physician 是比 doctor 更正式的說法，指醫師，多益常見於醫療保險、員工健檢、診所公告與診斷證明的情境。

example.en: Our clinic employs five physicians who speak English and Chinese.
example.zh: 我們的診所有五位會說中英文的醫師。

example.en: Please ask your family physician for a health report.
example.zh: 請向你的家庭醫師索取一份健康報告。

example.en: You should consult a physician before you start this program.
example.zh: 開始這個計畫前，你應該先諮詢醫師。

example.en: Only a licensed physician can sign this form.
example.zh: 只有有執照的醫師才能在這份表格上簽名。

examples.en: A physician will review the results of your health check.
examples.zh: 醫師會檢視你的健康檢查結果。

examples.en: The insurance plan covers visits to any physician in the network.
examples.zh: 這份保險涵蓋到網絡內任何醫師的看診。

examples.en: The physician asked the patient to rest for three days.
examples.zh: 醫師要求病人休息三天。

confusable.diff: physicist 是物理學家，拼法接近但和醫療無關。

example.en: The physicist gave a talk at the science conference.
example.zh: 這位物理學家在科學研討會上發表了演說。

similar.diff: doctor 是口語最常用的「醫生」；physician 較正式，多用於文件與公告。

example.en: I have an appointment with my doctor at noon.
example.zh: 我中午跟我的醫生有約。

example.en: The surgeon will explain the operation to the patient.
example.zh: 外科醫師會向病人說明手術內容。

example.en: The nurse will call your name when the doctor is ready.
example.zh: 護理師很快就會叫你的名字。

example.en: The clinic is closed on Sunday afternoons and all public holidays.
example.zh: 這間診所週日下午休診。

extra_vocab.en: to rub something until it is smooth and shiny, or to make something better
extra_vocab.note: polish 在多益有兩個常見用法：擦亮物品（polish the floor），以及把簡報、履歷、英文等「修飾得更好」（polish a presentation）。名詞則是亮光劑，如 shoe polish。

example.en: She polishes every report before she sends it to the client.
example.zh: 她在把每份報告寄給客戶前都會再修飾一遍。

example.en: The cleaner polished the lobby floor before the guests arrived.
example.zh: 清潔員在客人抵達前把大廳地板擦亮了。

example.en: The team gave a polished presentation to the investors.
example.zh: 團隊向投資人做了一場精緻的簡報。

example.en: He is polishing his résumé for the job fair tomorrow.
example.zh: 他正在為明天的就業博覽會修飾他的履歷。

example.en: We spent the evening polishing the presentation for the board.
example.zh: 我們花了一整個晚上潤飾要給董事會的簡報。

example.en: This course will help you polish your English skills.
example.zh: 這門課將幫助你磨練英文技能。

example.en: The hotel gives guests free shoe polish at the desk.
example.zh: 飯店在櫃檯免費提供客人鞋油。

examples.en: The staff polish the glass doors every morning before opening.
examples.zh: 員工每天早上開店前都會擦亮玻璃門。

examples.en: Please polish your cover letter before you apply for the job.
examples.zh: 申請工作之前，請先把你的求職信修飾好。

examples.en: The factory uses a special machine to polish the metal parts.
examples.zh: 這間工廠用特殊的機器擦亮金屬零件。

confusable.diff: Polish 開頭大寫，發音是 /ˈpoʊlɪʃ/，意思是「波蘭的；波蘭語」，和 polish 不同。
confusable.usage: 大寫的 Polish 是形容詞或名詞，與波蘭有關；小寫的 polish 發音不同，是動詞或名詞。

example.en: Our Polish partner will visit the office next week.
example.zh: 我們的波蘭夥伴下週會來辦公室拜訪。

similar.diff: improve 是一般的「改善」；polish 強調把已經不錯的東西修飾得更完美。

example.en: We need to improve the design of our website.
example.zh: 我們需要改善網站的設計。

example.en: The new floor shines under the office lights.
example.zh: 新地板在辦公室的燈光下閃閃發亮。

example.en: Please clean the meeting room after the lunch.
example.zh: 午餐後請清理會議室。

example.en: Please polish the table before the guests come.
example.zh: 客人來之前，請把桌子擦亮。

example.en: We bought a bottle of furniture polish for the office.
example.zh: 我們為辦公室買了一瓶家具亮光劑。

senses.en: to rub something until it is smooth and shiny

example.en: The staff polish the silver spoons before each dinner party.
example.zh: 員工在每場晚宴前都會擦亮銀湯匙。

senses.en: to make something better by small changes
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 speech、report、skills 這類抽象的東西時，是潤飾；受詞是 floor、shoes 這類物品時，是擦亮。

example.en: She polished her speech after getting advice from her boss.
example.zh: 她在聽取主管的建議後潤飾了她的演說稿。

extra_vocab.en: a baked food with a crust and a filling of fruit or meat
extra_vocab.note: pie 是派，多益常見於餐廳菜單、烘焙店與點心的情境；簡報中的 pie chart（圓餅圖）也很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 整個派是可數的 a pie；一片派說 a slice of pie 或 a piece of pie；泛指食物時可以不加冠詞：We serve pie.

example.en: The bakery sells about fifty fresh pies every morning.
example.zh: 這家烘焙店每天早上賣出大約五十個新鮮的派。

example.en: The café is famous for its warm apple pie.
example.zh: 這間咖啡店以熱騰騰的蘋果派聞名。

example.en: The pie chart shows how we spend our budget.
example.zh: 這張圓餅圖顯示我們如何使用預算。

example.en: Would you like a slice of pie with your coffee?
example.zh: 你的咖啡要不要配一片派？

examples.en: Today's special is chicken pie with a fresh green salad.
examples.zh: 今日特餐是雞肉派搭配新鮮的蔬菜沙拉。

examples.en: We bake every pie by hand using local fruit.
examples.zh: 我們用當地水果手工烘焙每一個派。

examples.en: The pie chart on page five compares sales in four regions.
examples.zh: 第五頁的圓餅圖比較了四個地區的銷售額。

example.en: We ordered a large cake for the office party.
example.zh: 我們為辦公室派對訂了一個大蛋糕。

example.en: Dessert is included in the price of the set meal.
example.zh: 套餐的價格包含甜點。

example.en: The bakery next door opens at six every morning.
example.zh: 隔壁的烘焙坊每天早上六點開門。

extra_vocab.en: a flat metal pot with a handle, used for cooking food
extra_vocab.note: pan 指平底鍋或烤盤，多益常見於廚房用品、餐廳廚房與家電賣場的情境，如 frying pan、baking pan。

example.en: The restaurant bought ten new pans for its kitchen.
example.zh: 這間餐廳為廚房買了十個新鍋子。

example.en: Heat the frying pan before you add the oil.
example.zh: 加油之前，請先把平底鍋加熱。

example.en: Put the cake mix into a baking pan.
example.zh: 把蛋糕麵糊倒進烤盤裡。

example.en: A non-stick pan is easy to clean after cooking.
example.zh: 不沾鍋在烹飪後很容易清洗。

examples.en: This pan is light enough for anyone to use easily.
examples.zh: 這個鍋子夠輕，任何人都能輕鬆使用。

examples.en: The chef cooked the fish in a large hot pan.
examples.zh: 主廚用一個很燙的大鍋子煎了魚。

examples.en: Customers can get a free pan when they buy the stove.
examples.zh: 顧客購買爐具時可獲贈一個鍋子。

confusable.diff: pen 是筆，拼法只差一個字母，發音也相近。

example.en: Please sign the contract with a blue pen.
example.zh: 請用藍筆在合約上簽名。

similar.diff: pot 是比較深、通常有蓋的鍋子，用來煮湯；pan 是淺的平底鍋，用來煎炒。

example.en: Add water and vegetables to the pot to make soup.
example.zh: 在鍋子裡加入水和蔬菜來煮湯。

example.en: Please turn off the stove before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請關掉爐子。

example.en: The restaurant kitchen is clean and well organized.
example.zh: 這間餐廳的廚房乾淨又井然有序。

example.en: We cook all our meals with fresh ingredients.
example.zh: 我們所有的餐點都用新鮮食材烹煮。

extra_vocab.en: an Italian food made from flour and water, such as spaghetti
extra_vocab.note: pasta 是義大利麵的總稱，多益常見於餐廳菜單、點餐對話與超市採購的情境，常見的有 spaghetti、macaroni 等。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: pasta 通常是不可數名詞：some pasta、a plate of pasta；談到好幾種不同的麵才用 pastas。

example.en: The restaurant offers five different pastas with fresh sauces.
example.zh: 這間餐廳提供五種不同的義大利麵，搭配新鮮醬汁。

example.en: We make our pasta sauce from fresh tomatoes.
example.zh: 我們用新鮮番茄製作義大利麵醬。

example.en: Cook the pasta for about ten minutes in hot water.
example.zh: 把義大利麵放進熱水中煮大約十分鐘。

example.en: Our best-selling pasta dish includes seafood and cream.
example.zh: 我們最暢銷的義大利麵料理含有海鮮和奶油。

examples.en: Today's lunch set comes with pasta, soup, and a drink.
examples.zh: 今天的午餐套餐有義大利麵、湯和一杯飲料。

examples.en: I would like the pasta with mushrooms, please.
examples.zh: 我想點蘑菇義大利麵，謝謝。

examples.en: We buy twenty boxes of pasta every month for the canteen.
examples.zh: 我們每個月為員工餐廳採購二十箱義大利麵。

confusable.diff: paste 是糊狀的醬或漿，拼法和 pasta 很像，意思不同。

example.en: Mix the tomato paste with water and some salt.
example.zh: 把番茄糊和水以及一點鹽混在一起。

similar.diff: noodles 是各種麵條的統稱，包括亞洲麵條；pasta 專指義大利式的麵食。

example.en: The shop sells fresh noodles made every morning.
example.zh: 這家店賣每天早上現做的新鮮麵條。

example.en: Please put the sauce on the side of the plate.
example.zh: 請把醬汁放在旁邊。

example.en: You can add extra cheese for two dollars.
example.zh: 你可以加兩美元多加起司。

extra_vocab.en: a small, hard piece of medicine that you swallow
extra_vocab.note: pill 是藥丸，口語最常用，多益常見於診所、藥局、保健食品與看診對話的情境，如 take a pill（吃藥）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「吃藥」動詞用 take：take a pill；不說 eat a pill 或 drink a pill。

example.en: The pharmacy sells vitamin pills at half price this week.
example.zh: 這間藥局本週的維他命藥丸半價。

example.en: Please take a pill after each meal for three days.
example.zh: 請在每餐飯後吃一顆藥，連續三天。

example.en: The doctor told him not to rely on sleeping pills.
example.zh: 醫師告訴他不要依賴安眠藥。

example.en: The company gives free vitamin pills to every employee.
example.zh: 公司提供每位員工免費的維他命藥丸。

examples.en: The doctor gave me pills for my headache.
examples.zh: 醫師給了我治頭痛的藥丸。

examples.en: This bottle holds sixty pills and costs twelve dollars.
examples.zh: 這瓶有六十顆藥丸，售價十二美元。

examples.en: Our new pill helps you stay awake during long trips.
examples.zh: 我們的新藥丸能幫助你在長途旅行中保持清醒。

confusable.diff: pillow 是枕頭，開頭拼法相同，但字尾多了 -ow，意思不同。

example.en: The hotel offers a soft pillow for each guest.
example.zh: 飯店為每位客人提供一個柔軟的枕頭。

similar.diff: tablet 是壓製成片的藥，語氣較正式；pill 是口語常用的藥丸。

example.en: Take one tablet with water in the morning.
example.zh: 早上用水服用一片藥。

example.en: Keep all medicine out of the reach of children.
example.zh: 請把所有藥物放在孩子拿不到的地方。

example.en: The pharmacy is open until ten every night.
example.zh: 這間藥局每天晚上開到十點。

example.en: You need a prescription to buy this medicine.
example.zh: 你需要處方箋才能買這種藥。
